what: Seconds from just before the Mac player process is started to: the first heartbeat.txt (the app is alive), the moment that file says audio=ok, and the player log line '[Downbeat] ready'.
how: script: tools/measure_boot_time.py 5; 5 runs; every run copies builds/mac (Downbeat.app and the content folder next to it) to a new folder and starts the player there with --input replay --mute --no-record --health-dir <that folder>/logs --quit-after 20 in a 960x540 window. The operating system's file cache was not dropped (that needs administrator rights), so this is a freshly copied app and content, not a cold disk.
machine: Apple M4 Pro (the Mac used for all Day 5 measurements), macOS 15.7.3
reading: The heartbeat is written from the first frame (first_beat_sec) and says audio=starting until the audio clock moves; it is rewritten at once when the state changes, so audio_ok_sec is the moment the sound came up. The game is ready (loaded content, samples) a little later. The Windows laptop has not been measured: its boot time is not known.
